QuestInfo.name: [Karote] The Second Statue
QuestInfo.1: Touching the #bstatue#k transported you to a new location. The enemies here are a bit stronger than before. Defeat them and find a way out.
QuestInfo.2:
In the #bstatue#k, you experienced someone else's memories.
He suffered through many experiments, plunged into the deep sea, and managed to build his way back to the surface. He called himself the #rAdversary#k...
